capabilities.title: Flutter-based cross-platform KeePass-compatible vault (mobile + desktop)
capabilities.sourceEvidence: AuthPass: Flutter app targeting iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, Web
capabilities.reason: Nexus is not a password manager; Flutter-based vault is outside scope.

capabilities.title: Mobile-optimized vault UX: biometric unlock, auto-lock on background
capabilities.sourceEvidence: AuthPass: biometric authentication and auto-lock policies
capabilities.reason: Nexus does not have a native mobile app or biometric unlock; mobile vault UX is outside scope.

capabilities.title: Cloud storage sync: Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, WebDAV vault file sync
capabilities.reason: Nexus syncs via git; third-party cloud storage integration for vault files is out of scope.

capabilities.title: Flutter/Dart architecture patterns for state management and local persistence
capabilities.sourceEvidence: AuthPass state management and Hive local storage
capabilities.reason: Nexus uses React, Zustand, and Tauri. Importing Flutter/Dart state and persistence architecture would duplicate the active platform without adding a user capability.
